items.headline: NFL Week 10: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
items.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 10.

items.headline: Joe Burrow and Bengals dominate Steelers 38-18 to take AFC North lead alone
items.description: — Joe Burrow passed for 409 yards and four touchdowns, Ja'Marr Chase had 11 catches for 231 yards and the Cincinnati Bengals dominated the Pittsburgh Steelers 38-18 on Sunday night to move into sole possession of first place in the AFC North.

items.headline: Steelers OL Mason McCormick carted off field with air cast on ankle
items.description: Steelers guard Mason McCormick had an air cast placed on his right ankle and was carted off the field with what appeared to be a serious injury Sunday night against the Bengals.
